title: Resolve existing Rust quality gate failures
description: Recovery validation with Rust 1.98.1: workspace cargo fmt --all -- --check reports existing formatting differences in lichen-core tests/ipv6_address_vectors.rs and yggdrasil_addr_vectors.rs, lichen-gateway src/gateway.rs, resources.rs, tunnel_auth.rs and tests/tunnel_auth_vectors.rs. cargo clippy --locked -p lichen-node --features std --tests -- -D warnings stops on seven chunks_exact_to_as_chunks lints in lichen-schc src/codec.rs and headers.rs. Existing lichen-node build warnings include duplicate SOS patterns in rpl_stack/receive.rs and unused remap_sender_iid in secure.rs. These files were untouched by recovery. Reconcile supported-toolchain/MSRV policy before adopting newer APIs; do not change human-only OSCORE internals for its separate existing dead-code warning.
acceptance_criteria: Relevant formatting and lint gates pass under project-supported toolchain with MSRV retained and no test weakening; changes reviewed independently.
